name: Highlife palm-mute synth guitar
desc: A zero-dependency take on the highlife guitar: crisp palm-muted triangle plucks (short decay, a touch of drive) arpeggiating the same I-vi-IV-V (E C#m A B) changes, with an off(1/8) octave-up interlock and a slow filter sweep. Squarer and drier than the wavetable version.

code.sparse: note('<[e4 ~ ~ b4 ~ ~ g#4 ~ ~ e5 ~ ~] [c#4 ~ ~ g#4 ~ ~ e4 ~ ~ c#5 ~ ~] [a4 ~ ~ e5 ~ ~ c#5 ~ ~ a5 ~ ~] [b4 ~ ~ f#5 ~ ~ d#5 ~ ~ b5 ~ ~]>').add(note(${root})).s('triangle').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}).slow(20)).decay(.18).sustain(.1).release(.1).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).orbit(4).play()
code.full: note('<[e4 g#4 b4 ~ e5 ~ b4 g#4 ~ e5 ~ b4] [c#4 e4 g#4 ~ c#5 ~ g#4 e4 ~ c#5 ~ g#4] [a4 c#5 e5 ~ a5 ~ e5 c#5 ~ a5 ~ e5] [b4 d#5 f#5 ~ b5 ~ f#5 d#5 ~ b5 ~ f#5]>').add(note(${root})).s('triangle').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).decay(.16).sustain(.1).release(.1).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.6)).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note('<[e4 g#4 b4 e5 b4 g#4 e4 g#4 b4 e5 b4 g#4] [c#4 e4 g#4 c#5 g#4 e4 c#4 e4 g#4 c#5 g#4 e4] [a4 c#5 e5 a5 e5 c#5 a4 c#5 e5 a5 e5 c#5] [b4 d#5 f#5 b5 f#5 d#5 b4 d#5 f#5 b5 f#5 d#5]>').add(note(${root})).s('triangle').lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*1.6).slow(12)).lpq(2).decay(.14).sustain(.08).release(.08).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.6)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(4).play()
